resolution: Fixed the visible wall-face snap miss by adding a wall-specific edge-snap path. Wall hits now use the target wall's authored line/endpoints instead of the shifted physical face: end-cap hits extend collinearly, side-face hits near an endpoint turn the corner on the aimed side, and side-face hits away from endpoints stay on the same wall line/base Y. Floor/roof side faces remain blocked for wall-on-floor. Added REQ-0471 regression tests. Verified build-snap 18/18, build-placed 45/45, and full hmsc-int esbuild bundle.
